But his assignment requires him to go undercover as their coach and live in their house, and so, some ground rules are in order. (Comedy) - 2005

Facing pressure from all sides of the community, Starr must find her voice and decide to stand up for what's right. (Crime drama) - 2018

When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama) - 2009

starzencorewest.us.title: Mr. 3000

Together, the young duo joins forces with Han Solo (Harrison Ford) to make sure the Resistance receives the intelligence concerning the whereabouts of Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), the last of the Jedi Knights. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2015

When Griffin decides that the only way to get a girlfriend is to find a more glamorous career, the animals panic. To keep him from leaving, they reveal their secret ability to talk and offer to teach him the rules of courtship, animal style. (Family, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2011

When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline. The download soon draws attention from an NSA agent who traces the activity to Stockholm. Further problems arise when Russian thugs take Lisbeth's laptop and kidnap a math whiz who can make Firewall work. Now, Lisbeth and an unlikely ally must race against time to save the boy and recover the codes to avert disaster. (Action, Thriller) - 2018

starzencoreclassic.us.title: John Q

Archibald (Denzel Washington) takes a hospital emergency room hostage in a last-ditch attempt to save his child. (Drama) - 2002

But they run into trouble when a crooked lawman hits them with a phony murder charge. Ray and Claude are given life sentences and shipped off to jail, where they must think of a way to prove their innocence and avoid the brutal guards while battling their biggest enemies -- their opposing personalities. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama) - 2017
